name: Keyword Tool Pro
description:
Keyword Tool Pro brings full-powered keyword research into Claude for SEO, content, and PPC teams. Connect your KeywordTool.io account and Claude pulls real keyword ideas from Google and Bing autocomplete, then enriches every keyword with 100% accurate search volume, competition, and trend data sourced directly from Google Keyword Planner and Bing Keyword Planner.

Unlike the free connector, Pro returns full metrics on every result - not just a sample - plus competitor research and high-volume bulk lookups.

What you can do:
- Generate up to 1,000 keyword ideas per search from Google and Bing (suggestions, questions, prepositions, related)
- Get 100% accurate search volume, competition, trends, CPC (Bing), and top-of-page bid estimates (Google) on every keyword
- Look up search volume in bulk - paste up to 1,000 keywords per request
- Analyze any competitor or domain on Google to uncover the keywords they rank and bid for
- Research across 100+ countries and languages
- Check your remaining quota anytime

Try prompts like:
- "Get search volume and competition for these 50 keywords"
- "Find keyword ideas with search volume for 'standing desk'"
- "What keywords does competitor.com target on Google?"
- "Compare Google and Bing search volume for 'running shoes'"
- "Show top-of-page bid estimates for my 'home espresso' keywords on Google"

Trusted by over 1,000,000 marketers and SEO & PPC teams at companies like Microsoft, eBay, and Adobe. Higher daily limits scale with your plan - up to 400,000 keywords per day on the Agency plan.

Requires a paid KeywordTool.io plan. Sign in via secure OAuth when you connect. Currently supports Google and Bing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Keyword Tool Pro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Keyword Tool Pro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.keywordtool.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Keyword Tool Pro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keyword Tool Pro provides these MCP tools: keywordtool-analyze-competitors, keywordtool-quota, keywordtool-search-volume, and keywordtool-suggestions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Keyword Tool Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Keyword Tool Pro in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Keyword Tool Pro MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keyword Tool Pro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Keyword Tool Pro is developed by Essential Apps LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
